blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Congress should tighten national animal welfare laws following the illegal dumping of 25 dead pets in Bulacan, Mamamayang Liberal Rep. Leila de Lima said on Sunday. On Friday, animal welfare group Luna and Furry Siblings sparked widespread outrage after it exposed on social media how the remains of several dogs and cats were “thrown away like trash” in San Jose Del Monte city. Reports subsequently revealed that the pets were discarded rather than cremated as intended by their owners. “This kind of violence should never be tolerated,” de Lima, the second-ranking minority lawmaker in the House of Representatives, […]...
